hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook backed by Euler Protocol vaults. Each pool instance is a minimal proxy using a configurable pricing curve (with concentration and equilibrium reserve parameters). It handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap via a return delta, routing token flows through Euler vaults rather than native Uniswap v4 liquidity, and intentionally blocks native liquidity additions and donations.
